routes.name_es: Revalidación del título profesional de Médico Cirujano por la Universidad de Chile
routes.what_it_produces: A Universidad de Chile diploma/resolution certifying equivalence between the Ukrainian medical qualification and the Chilean title Médico Cirujano. It permits ordinary private medical practice, subject to immigration and other sector rules. It does not replace EUNACOM for the public posts listed in Law 20.261, FONASA’s Modalidad de Libre Elección, issuing medical-leave certificates, or publicly funded/hosted postgraduate and specialty programmes.
routes.who_runs_it: Universidad de Chile, Oficina de Revalidación de Títulos Extranjeros, under DFL 3/2006 article 6—not under Decreto 174/2024 for professional titles.
routes.account_creation: A Cuenta UChile is created at https://cuenta.uchile.cl/ using either a valid passport or Chilean identity card. No RUT or ClaveÚnica is required to create the foreign-applicant account.
steps: Create Cuenta UChile and enter Ucampus.
Upload the apostilled/legalised medical diploma, transcript, study plan, detailed syllabi, Ukrainian professional-habilitation evidence, passport and Spanish translations.
Pay the 2 UTM admission fee from a Chilean bank account.
Book the document-verification appointment; an authorised third party may attend with an apostilled/notarised power.
Pay 3 UTM for the curricular assessment.
Complete any examinations, clinical practice, courses or final-degree requirements imposed by the Faculty of Medicine.
Receive the final revalidation resolution and diploma.
routes.cost: Currently 2 UTM for admission plus 3 UTM for academic assessment. Any additional academic requirements are priced separately by the faculty. The published instructions require the first payment in Chilean pesos from a Chilean bank account.
routes.duration: Published minimum: six months. The faculty has 60 working days for its curricular study after payment, but document review, appointments and additional requirements can make the total substantially longer.
routes.evidence_quote: “A la Universidad de Chile le corresponde la atribución de reconocer, revalidar y convalidar títulos profesionales obtenidos en el extranjero”. “Crear o recuperar Cuenta Uchile”. “cédula de identidad chilena o pasaporte (no los dos)”
routes.history_note: Universidad de Chile formerly had exclusive practical control. Law 21.325 removed the words “privativa y excluyente”; since 17 August 2026 other qualifying State universities can also revalidate professional titles. Universidad de Chile nevertheless retains its separate statutory route.

routes.name_es: Revalidación del título profesional de Médico Cirujano por otra universidad estatal
routes.what_it_produces: A revalidation diploma identifying the foreign medical title and the equivalent Chilean Médico Cirujano title. It can support ordinary private practice, but it does not satisfy functions for which Law 20.261 separately requires EUNACOM.
routes.who_runs_it: A Chilean State university satisfying Decreto 174/2024 article 5 and having an accredited medical programme with a graduated cohort.
routes.why_not: Nationality is not a barrier. A particular State university must be legally eligible, must actually accept medical revalidation applications, and must find sufficient curricular equivalence. No indexed university-specific medicine portal was found as of 6 September 2026.
routes.account_creation: No common national account exists. Decreto 174 permits identification with a passport, foreign national identity document, travel document or Chilean identity card. The selected university must publish its own procedure and portal.
steps: Select an eligible State university that teaches accredited Medicine and has a graduated cohort.
File with its Unidad Coordinadora using the apostilled/legalised diploma, transcript, curriculum, home-country habilitation, passport and required translations.
Pass admissibility and curricular assessment.
If equivalence is at least 70% but incomplete, complete examinations, clinical practice, final activities or additional courses.
Receive the revalidation diploma.
routes.cost: National maxima under Decreto Exento 384/2026: 2 UTM for filing/admissibility; 3 UTM for assessment; up to 15 UTM for examinations/final activities; up to 20 UTM for additional curricular activities. Universities may charge less or grant exemptions; document-issuance fees may be additional.
routes.duration: The coordinating unit has 30 working days to request the academic report; the academic unit has 45 working days for its study and 15 further working days for its proposal. Additional requirements may be scheduled across no more than three semesters; the applicant normally has up to two years, with one reasoned extension.
routes.evidence_quote: “Solo las universidades del Estado con un mínimo de acreditación institucional de nivel avanzado de cinco años”. “hasta 2 unidades tributarias mensuales”
routes.history_note: This route became legally operative on 17 August 2026. It did not replace Universidad de Chile’s independent statutory authority.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento — no revalidación — del título profesional médico bajo el Decreto 174/2024
routes.what_it_produces: Nothing for a medical-practice application: simple reconocimiento would merely certify that the foreign qualification is nationally comparable, but Decreto 174 excludes this procedure where the corresponding Chilean credential is indispensable for professional practice. Medicine therefore requires revalidación, EUNACOM or a treaty/exception route.
routes.who_runs_it: Potentially qualifying State universities, but they must reject reconocimiento as the selected procedure for a practising medical title.
routes.why_not: The obstacle is the regulated nature of medicine, not Ukrainian nationality. Médico Cirujano is indispensable for lawful diagnosis and treatment in Chile, so the applicable university procedure is revalidación, not simple reconocimiento.
routes.account_creation: None, because this is not the legally appropriate application type for the medical-practice title.
steps: Do not apply for simple professional-title reconocimiento as a substitute for medical revalidation.
Choose professional revalidación, complete EUNACOM, or use an applicable treaty/exception route instead.
routes.cost: Not applicable.
routes.duration: Not applicable.
routes.evidence_quote: “El reconocimiento solo procederá… [cuando] no sea requisito indispensable para el ejercicio profesional en Chile.” “Sólo podrán desempeñar actividades propias de la medicina… quienes poseen el título respectivo”
routes.history_note: This distinction was expressly codified in the regulation effective 17 August 2026.

routes.name_es: EUNACOM completo como revalidación automática
routes.what_it_produces: After passing both the theoretical and practical sections, the applicant holds an EUNACOM certificate and is automatically deemed to have revalidated the Chilean professional title Médico Cirujano. It opens the public posts listed in Law 20.261, FONASA MLE, authority to issue medical-leave certificates and eligibility for publicly funded/hosted postgraduate or specialty programmes. It does not certify rheumatology or recognise the PhD.
routes.who_runs_it: The association representing the largest number of Chilean medical schools—operationally ASOFAMECH/EUNACOM—under Ministry of Health regulation.
routes.online_portal_url: https://reservas.eunacom.cl/ for the mandatory first-time appointment; https://inscripcion.eunacom.cl/ is available only to candidates who have previously sat EUNACOM and for the practical section
routes.account_creation: A valid passport is expressly accepted where the foreign graduate has not obtained a Chilean identity card. First-time foreign graduates must file in person, although a third party may attend with a simple power.
steps: Prepare the apostilled medical title, passport, professional-habilitation evidence and translations.
Pay the EUNACOM-ST fee and reserve an in-person registration appointment.
Register personally or through an authorised third party.
Pass EUNACOM-ST.
While the ST result remains valid, register for and pass all required EUNACOM-SP components.
Obtain the full EUNACOM certificate; automatic revalidation follows by law.
routes.cost: Current published fees: CLP 310,000 for ST; CLP 720,000 for all four SP stages, CLP 655,000 for two or three stages, or CLP 470,000 for one stage.
routes.duration: Calendar-dependent. The 2026 ST sittings are 8 July and 16 December. Passing the practical stages can require additional cycles; the ST result is normally valid for two years. Full EUNACOM approval is indefinite.
routes.evidence_quote: “habrán revalidado automáticamente su título profesional de médico cirujano”. “con pasaporte vigente si aún no han obtenido su cédula chilena”
routes.history_note: Since 24 May 2025, EUNACOM is also required to issue medical-leave certificates. Updated examination rules took effect on 1 January 2026.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento y registro por convenios bilaterales ante MINREL
routes.what_it_produces: A Ministry of Foreign Affairs recognition-and-registration certificate which permits professional exercise in Chile, subject to the same sector-specific requirements applicable to Chilean doctors, including EUNACOM-controlled public functions.
routes.who_runs_it: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores, Departamento de Registro y Reconocimiento de Títulos.
routes.why_not: The current bilateral route covers titles obtained in Brazil, Peru and Uruguay. A medical degree obtained in Ukraine is outside those agreements; citizenship alone would not change the degree’s country of origin.
routes.account_creation: No Chilean RUT or ClaveÚnica is required. The portal permits RUT, DNI or passport plus a unique validation code sent by email.
steps: Create the online request using the eligible title and identity document.
Upload the original title, transcript and institutional evidence requested by MINREL.
Attend any required document review or interview.
Receive the recognition-and-registration certificate.
routes.cost: Free. Translation services, apostilles and document preparation can have separate costs.
routes.duration: No reliable fixed completion period was published on the fetched current portal.
routes.evidence_quote: “Actualmente, se encuentran vigentes los convenios bilaterales con Brasil, Perú y Uruguay.” “Este trámite no tiene costo.”
routes.history_note: Older guidance sometimes lists Colombia, Ecuador, Argentina or Spain under MINREL. Current allocation differs: Argentina, Ecuador, Spain and the United Kingdom/Northern Ireland are handled by MINEDUC; Guatemala left the Mexico Convention route on 1 January 2025.

routes.name_es: Convención de México: reconocimiento de título médico previo examen general
routes.what_it_produces: After the Universidad de Chile general health-profession examination is passed and MINREL completes registration, the applicant receives the treaty recognition certificate. It can authorise professional exercise, but does not itself satisfy every EUNACOM-specific public-sector function.
routes.who_runs_it: MINREL receives the application and sends the medical case to Universidad de Chile for the treaty examination.
routes.why_not: The degree must have been issued in Bolivia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua or Peru. Ukraine is not a State Party covered by this Chilean procedure.
routes.account_creation: RUT, DNI or passport, together with the validation code emailed by the portal.
steps: File the treaty recognition application with MINREL.
MINREL sends the health-profession dossier to Universidad de Chile.
Pass the required general examination.
Return to MINREL for recognition and registration.
routes.cost: The MINREL recognition stage is free. A current published charge for the Universidad de Chile treaty examination was not found.
routes.duration: No current fixed total period was found; it depends on Universidad de Chile examination scheduling and subsequent MINREL registration.
routes.evidence_quote: “deben rendir previamente un examen general… el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores… los remite a la Universidad de Chile”
routes.history_note: Guatemala ceased to be covered from 1 January 2025. The current portal directs Guatemalan titles to the ordinary university route.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento por convenios administrados por MINEDUC
routes.what_it_produces: An official MINEDUC recognition of an eligible title from Argentina, Ecuador, Spain or the United Kingdom/Northern Ireland. Its professional effect is subject to the relevant treaty and Chile’s regulated-profession requirements; it is not automatically a rheumatology certification or EUNACOM certificate.
routes.who_runs_it: Ministerio de Educación, Subsecretaría de Educación Superior.
routes.why_not: The person’s medical and academic degrees were obtained in Ukraine, which is covered by none of these agreements.
routes.account_creation: No applicant account was identified. Current instructions use country-specific email channels: titulos.argentina@mineduc.cl, titulos.espana@mineduc.cl, titulos.uk@mineduc.cl and, for Ecuador, the published administrative procedure. Passport or identity-card copies are used as identification; no ClaveÚnica filing portal was found.
steps: Confirm that the awarding country, institution, programme and accreditation meet the applicable treaty.
Send the prescribed documents to the appropriate MINEDUC channel.
MINEDUC verifies the title and treaty conditions.
Receive the recognition resolution/certificate.
routes.cost: No common current fee was stated on the fetched MINEDUC procedure page.
routes.duration: No common statutory completion period was stated on that page.
routes.evidence_quote: “Argentina, España y Reino Unido e Irlanda del Norte.” “El objeto del presente Convenio es el mutuo reconocimiento de títulos profesionales… [con] Ecuador”
routes.history_note: Ecuador’s current 2015 agreement replaced the old 1917 convention administered by MINREL on 26 February 2017.

routes.name_es: Facultad discrecional del MINEDUC del artículo 143 de la Ley 21.325
routes.what_it_produces: If activated for a listed qualification, MINEDUC could itself recognise, revalidate or convalidate it, or arrange this through an eligible higher-education institution. No published evidence was found that a Ukrainian medical or doctoral qualification is currently on such a list.
routes.who_runs_it: MINEDUC directly or through agreements with qualifying State universities.
routes.why_not: The statute requires an updated published list of eligible titles. No live list or application process including this Ukrainian medical degree was located as of 6 September 2026.
routes.account_creation: Not published or not found.
steps: Check whether MINEDUC publishes the statutory list and includes the exact Ukrainian qualification.
If listed, follow the procedure established by the implementing regulation or agreement.
Until then, use an operational university, EUNACOM or another applicable route.
routes.cost: Not published or not found.
routes.duration: Not published or not found.
routes.evidence_quote: “El Ministerio de Educación siempre podrá establecer… el reconocimiento y revalidación de títulos profesionales… y grados académicos”
routes.history_note: The power exists in the statute, but the fetched Decreto 174 procedure and current MINEDUC pages did not reveal a separately operational applicant route or qualifying-title list.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento del grado académico de Doctor por la Universidad de Chile
routes.what_it_produces: A certificate accepting the foreign academic degree and assimilating it to the Chilean academic degree Doctor. It is useful as formal Chilean evidence for academic recruitment, promotion and research, but it does not authorise medical practice or certify rheumatology.
routes.who_runs_it: Universidad de Chile under its own statute and university regulations.
routes.why_not: Universidad de Chile must decide that the Ukrainian Candidate of Medical Sciences qualification is academically comparable to a Chilean Doctor degree. There is no automatic equivalence.
routes.account_creation: Cuenta UChile using the passport at https://cuenta.uchile.cl/; no RUT or ClaveÚnica is required.
steps: Create Cuenta UChile and select academic-degree reconocimiento.
Upload the apostilled degree, transcript, programme/study-plan evidence, thesis or equivalent, passport and translations.
Pay the intake and academic-assessment fees.
Attend or arrange the original-document verification.
Receive approval or refusal; reconocimiento does not allow remedial examinations.
routes.cost: Currently 2 UTM for intake and 3 UTM for academic assessment, plus any published certificate fee.
routes.duration: Published minimum for the Universidad de Chile process: six months.
routes.evidence_quote: “Reconocimiento: Certificación del título o grado extranjero, mediante la asimilación con el respectivo grado académico chileno”
routes.history_note: Academic recognition remains distinct from recognition or revalidation of the professional medical title.

routes.name_es: Revalidación del grado académico de Doctor por la Universidad de Chile
routes.what_it_produces: A diploma certifying equivalence between the foreign academic degree and a specific academic degree awarded by Universidad de Chile. It supplies academic equivalence only; it does not create medical-practice or specialty rights.
routes.who_runs_it: Universidad de Chile under its independent statutory authority.
routes.why_not: The applicant must select a corresponding Universidad de Chile degree, and the university must find sufficient equivalence. The Ukrainian Candidate degree is not automatically a Chilean doctorate.
routes.account_creation: Cuenta UChile opened with a valid passport or Chilean identity card.
steps: Select an appropriate Chilean doctoral degree for comparison.
Submit the academic dossier, thesis/equivalent, passport and translations through Ucampus.
Pay the applicable fees and verify originals.
Complete any academic requirements imposed in a revalidation case.
Receive the revalidation diploma if approved.
routes.cost: 2 UTM intake plus 3 UTM assessment under the current Universidad de Chile schedule; additional academic requirements are separately notified.
routes.duration: At least six months; longer if additional requirements are imposed.
routes.evidence_quote: “Aprobación, Denegación o Cumplimiento de Exigencias Académicas”
routes.history_note: Unlike reconocimiento, revalidación compares the foreign degree to a specific Chilean degree and may impose additional academic work.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento del grado académico por otra universidad estatal
routes.what_it_produces: A recognition certificate stating that the foreign degree is assimilable to Licenciado, Magíster or Doctor. For this person, a favourable result could state Doctor. It supports academic use but provides no medical-practice entitlement.
routes.who_runs_it: An eligible State university under Decreto 174/2024 that teaches an appropriate accredited/qualifying doctoral programme with a graduated cohort.
routes.why_not: The university must accept the application and decide that the Candidate of Medical Sciences qualification is assimilable to Doctor. No live institution-specific doctoral portal was found.
routes.account_creation: No common account. The regulation accepts passport, foreign national identity document, travel document or Chilean identity card.
steps: Identify an eligible State university with an appropriate doctoral programme.
File with its Unidad Coordinadora, including the degree, transcripts, programme information, thesis/equivalent, passport and translations.
Undergo the academic assessment.
Receive an approval-or-refusal decision; no remedial requirements are permitted in reconocimiento.
routes.cost: Maximum 2 UTM for filing and 3 UTM for academic assessment; the university may charge less or grant an exemption.
routes.duration: Statutory assessment milestones are 30, 45 and 15 working days, although no fixed end-to-end period is guaranteed.
routes.evidence_quote: “solo se les reconocerá si son asimilables… a un grado de licenciado, magíster o doctor”
routes.history_note: This became available outside Universidad de Chile on 17 August 2026, subject to each State university actually implementing it.

routes.name_es: Revalidación del grado académico por otra universidad estatal
routes.what_it_produces: A revalidation diploma certifying equivalence with a specific Chilean degree awarded by that State university. It may help an academic career but does not authorise clinical medicine.
routes.who_runs_it: An eligible State university under Decreto 174/2024 with a corresponding qualifying programme.
routes.why_not: It depends on a university offering and accepting comparison with an appropriate Chilean doctorate and finding the required equivalence.
routes.account_creation: No common account or central portal; passport and foreign national identity documents are legally acceptable.
steps: Choose an eligible university and corresponding degree.
File the complete apostilled academic dossier with its Unidad Coordinadora.
Complete curricular assessment and any permitted remedial requirements.
Receive the specific-degree equivalence diploma.
routes.cost: National maxima are 2 UTM, 3 UTM, 15 UTM and 20 UTM by the applicable procedural stage, plus a possible published document fee.
routes.duration: Baseline statutory review milestones are 30, 45 and 15 working days. Additional requirements may extend across up to three semesters, with normally two years to complete them and one possible extension.
routes.evidence_quote: “Revalidación… certificación de equivalencia entre… un grado académico obtenido en el extranjero… [y un] grado otorgado por una institución… nacional”
routes.history_note: Newly live from 17 August 2026.

routes.name_es: Convalidación de actividades curriculares y obtención posterior de un nuevo título chileno
routes.what_it_produces: Convalidación alone produces recognition of specified foreign courses, not recognition of the Ukrainian degree. If admitted and all remaining Chilean medical-programme requirements are completed, the person ultimately receives a new Chilean Médico Cirujano title. EUNACOM remains necessary for the functions listed in Law 20.261.
routes.who_runs_it: For professional-title curricula, qualifying State universities under Decreto 174/2024; Universidad de Chile is also covered by that decree for curricular convalidation.
routes.why_not: The university must admit the person, accept enough foreign courses and require completion of the rest of its medical curriculum. This may approach repeating substantial parts of medical school.
routes.account_creation: Institution-specific student-admission account; no common national portal or uniform identity requirement was found.
steps: Apply for admission/transfer to a Chilean medical programme.
Request convalidation of the Ukrainian curricular activities.
Complete all non-convalidated courses, clinical rotations and graduation requirements.
Receive the university’s Chilean Médico Cirujano title.
Complete EUNACOM where the intended work requires it.
routes.cost: Up to 2 UTM for filing and up to 3 UTM for the convalidation analysis under Decreto 384. Normal tuition and graduation costs for the remaining Chilean programme are separate.
routes.duration: Determined by the amount of curriculum accepted and the remaining programme; no general maximum for completing the new degree was found.
routes.evidence_quote: “convalidar actividades curriculares cursadas en una institución de educación superior extranjera”. “hasta 3 unidades tributarias mensuales”
routes.history_note: This is a study-transfer/new-degree pathway, not revalidation of the completed Ukrainian degree.

routes.name_es: Certificación ordinaria de especialidad médica obtenida en el extranjero ante CONACEM
routes.what_it_produces: A CONACEM diploma certifying the medical specialty, potentially rheumatology. With a separately enabled Médico Cirujano title, it allows the holder to present and work as a certified specialist within the sectors opened by the base-title route. By itself it does not revalidate the medical title; the article 2 bis exception is listed separately.
routes.who_runs_it: Corporación Nacional Autónoma de Certificación de Especialidades Médicas, an authorised specialty-certification entity.
routes.why_not: CONACEM currently permits registration only with a Chilean RUT. The applicant must also prove an actual formal foreign specialist title/training programme; being an associate professor of rheumatology by itself is insufficient.
routes.account_creation: Chilean RUT is mandatory. Passport-only registration is expressly unavailable.
steps: Obtain a Chilean RUT.
Create the CONACEM physician account.
Upload notarised/apostilled medical and specialist titles, specialist programme, records, CV, ethics evidence and employment certificate.
Undergo committee review.
Pass the written and practical examinations if required for foreign training.
Receive the specialty diploma and arrange RNPI specialty recording.
routes.cost: CLP 230,000 certification charge; foreign-training applicants additionally pay CLP 300,000 for each written examination attempt and CLP 450,000 for each practical attempt.
routes.duration: No fixed total period. It depends on committee review and examination calendars.
routes.evidence_quote: “A contar del 1º de septiembre 2024, el requisito para postular será sólo con RUT Chileno.” “se les entregará un diploma”
routes.history_note: Since 1 September 2024 CONACEM’s account has required a Chilean RUT.

routes.name_es: Certificación excepcional de especialidad bajo el artículo 2 bis de la Ley 20.261
routes.what_it_produces: Certification of a specific specialty or subspecialty by a MINSAL-authorised entity. Even without general Chilean habilitation or EUNACOM, it authorises practice only in that certified specialty and only in the public sector. It does not authorise general medicine or private practice.
routes.who_runs_it: Any entity authorised by MINSAL for the particular specialty, including examples such as CONACEM, Universidad de Santiago and ACUDEC/Universidad de Concepción.
routes.why_not: She must prove a certifiable foreign specialty—not merely teaching experience—and satisfy the chosen certifier’s procedure. CONACEM’s portal requires a Chilean RUT; procedures at other authorised certifiers vary.
routes.online_portal_url: https://www.conacem.cl/registro.asp for CONACEM; NONE as a single portal covering all authorised certifiers
routes.account_creation: CONACEM requires a Chilean RUT. Identity/account requirements for other certifiers are institution-specific.
steps: Identify a MINSAL-authorised entity that certifies rheumatology.
Submit the foreign specialist qualification and training evidence.
Complete its assessment and examinations.
Obtain certification.
Practise only rheumatology, and only in the public sector, until a general professional-title route is completed.
routes.cost: CONACEM’s published charges are those stated in the preceding route. Other certifiers set their own charges; no national common fee was found.
routes.duration: Certifier- and examination-dependent; no national fixed period.
routes.evidence_quote: “quedará habilitado para ejercer en Chile solamente esa especialidad y sólo en el sector público”
routes.history_note: Created by Law 20.985 in 2017 as a permanent exceptional specialist route; it is different from the expired pandemic arrangements.

routes.name_es: Inscripción en el Registro Nacional de Prestadores Individuales de Salud (RNPI)
routes.what_it_produces: A public RNPI entry recording the already validated professional title and, where applicable, specialty. It does not recognise or revalidate a degree. Registration is generally not a prerequisite for practising the profession, but is required for AUGE/GES guaranteed services.
routes.who_runs_it: Superintendencia de Salud.
routes.why_not: She must first obtain a qualifying Chilean title recognition/revalidation, EUNACOM result or article 2 bis specialty certification. The available online authentication paths require a Chilean RUT; she presently has none.
routes.account_creation: With ClaveÚnica, authenticate through the linked ClaveÚnica service; without ClaveÚnica, the linked document-login service asks for RUT and identity-document number. Passport-only online filing was not verified.
steps: Complete a valid medical-title or specialty route.
Apply online or at a Superintendencia office.
The Superintendencia validates the credential with the habilitating entity.
The title/specialty is entered in the public registry.
routes.cost: Free.
routes.duration: Case-by-case, depending on confirmation from official sources.
routes.evidence_quote: “previa validación de la entidad habilitante”. “la inscripción… no constituye un requisito para el ejercicio de la respectiva profesión”
routes.history_note: RNPI is a downstream registry, not a fourth general degree-recognition mechanism.

routes.name_es: Autorización sanitaria del artículo 112 del Código Sanitario para barcos, islas o lugares apartados
routes.what_it_produces: An individual sanitary-authority resolution permitting work as a doctor at the specified ship, island or remote place. It does not revalidate the title and creates no general nationwide or private-practice right.
routes.who_runs_it: The competent SEREMI de Salud, exercising the relevant sanitary-authority powers.
routes.why_not: It requires proof of the foreign medical title, a genuinely remote qualifying post and discretionary sanitary authorisation. It is not an applicant-controlled general migration pathway.
routes.account_creation: No dedicated current applicant account or portal was found. The process is normally employer/SEREMI-driven; published passport-versus-RUT requirements were not located.
steps: Secure or identify a qualifying post on a ship, island or remote location.
The employer/applicant presents the foreign title and supporting need to the competent SEREMI.
Obtain the express article 112 resolution before treating patients.
Work only within the authorised location and conditions.
routes.cost: Not published or not found.
routes.duration: Not published or not found.
routes.evidence_quote: “podrán desempeñarse como médicos… en barcos, islas o lugares apartados… [quienes] acreditaren título profesional otorgado en el extranjero”
routes.history_note: This long-standing narrow exception is a temporary/local authorisation, not title recognition.

routes.name_es: Contratación pública excepcional por escasez imprescindible de médicos — jurisprudencia de Contraloría
routes.what_it_produces: A temporary public-health contract/administrative authorisation despite not having passed EUNACOM, when genuine scarcity makes the hire indispensable to maintain health services. It produces no revalidated title and no right to private practice or to demand employment.
routes.who_runs_it: The relevant public Health Service or municipality, subject to sanitary authority and the binding administrative criteria developed by Contraloría General de la República.
routes.why_not: A public employer must establish actual exceptional scarcity and indispensability. The route is discretionary, temporary and employer-driven. Lack of Chilean work status/RUT remains a practical barrier.
routes.account_creation: None; there is no personal recognition account. The employer documents the exceptional need and contract.
steps: A public employer identifies and proves an exceptional shortage.
The employer verifies the genuine foreign medical qualification.
It obtains the necessary administrative/sanitary authorisation and contracts the physician temporarily.
The physician remains limited to the authorised public work and should pursue ordinary habilitation.
routes.cost: No applicant recognition fee was found.
routes.duration: Only for the justified temporary shortage; no uniform period.
routes.evidence_quote: “procedimiento excepcional por la vía de un permiso temporal estatal”. “en situaciones especiales de escasez de médicos… [es admisible] la contratación”
routes.history_note: The doctrine derives from Contraloría opinions including Dictamen 12.393/2016 and remained referenced in official regulatory material. It is not a general substitute for EUNACOM.

routes.name_es: Exención territorial y temporal de EUNACOM durante la alerta sanitaria del Decreto 64/2026
routes.what_it_produces: No new credential. It temporarily allows designated public Health Services to contract doctors whose foreign title is already revalidated even though they have not finished EUNACOM. It does not help a completely unrevalidated Ukrainian title.
routes.who_runs_it: Health Services in Tarapacá, Antofagasta, Atacama and Coquimbo under MINSAL’s active emergency powers.
routes.why_not: She must first revalidate the medical title through Universidad de Chile or another valid route, secure immigration/work status and be hired by a covered Health Service before the alert ends.
routes.account_creation: None; employer-driven public hiring.
steps: First obtain revalidation of the foreign medical title.
Apply to a covered regional Health Service.
If hired under the decree, work despite incomplete EUNACOM while the emergency authority remains effective.
Complete EUNACOM for durable public-sector eligibility.
routes.cost: No separate applicant fee.
routes.duration: Live on 6 September 2026 but scheduled to expire on 31 October 2026 unless terminated earlier or extended.
routes.evidence_quote: “Contratar médicos… [cuyo] título se encuentre revalidado, aun cuando no hayan finalizado… Eunacom.” “Región de Tarapacá… Región de Antofagasta”
routes.history_note: An earlier fire-emergency waiver under Decreto 2/2026 expired on 31 March 2026. The present route is a separate, currently live weather-emergency measure.

routes.name_es: Ingreso directo a docencia universitaria con diploma extranjero apostillado — sin reconocimiento previo
routes.what_it_produces: An academic appointment or employment contract, not a Chilean degree-recognition certificate. Universidad de Chile’s published career rules expressly accept an apostilled/legalised foreign professional title or degree for competition entry. This supports non-clinical teaching and research; any patient diagnosis or treatment still requires a medical-practice route.
routes.who_runs_it: The recruiting university. The directly verified rule is Universidad de Chile’s; other universities apply their own appointment regulations.
routes.why_not: She must win the relevant academic competition and obtain lawful immigration/work status. Her Ukrainian title and doctorate may be submitted directly at Universidad de Chile, but the foreign rank “associate professor” is not automatically transferred.
routes.account_creation: No central account. Each faculty publishes its vacancy and application mechanism; passport identification may be used initially, but employment requires compliance with immigration rules.
steps: Monitor medical-faculty academic vacancies.
Submit the apostilled/legalised degree, CV, publications and teaching record.
Win the public or institutional selection process.
Obtain suitable Chilean immigration/work status.
Perform teaching/research only; obtain medical habilitation before undertaking clinical care.
routes.cost: No degree-recognition fee. Normal document apostille/translation and immigration costs remain.
routes.duration: Determined by the recruitment competition and immigration process.
routes.evidence_quote: “diploma o certificado respectivo, debidamente legalizado o apostillado si éste hubiere sido otorgado en el extranjero”
routes.history_note: This is an employment route, not reconocimiento or revalidación. Formal academic recognition can nevertheless strengthen or simplify proof of the doctorate.

routes.name_es: Actividad académica breve de extranjero domiciliado fuera de Chile — hasta 90 días
routes.what_it_produces: A statutory exemption from requesting the special remunerated-activity authorisation for qualifying university-organised academic work lasting no more than 90 days or the transient-stay period. It produces no recognised degree, residence, medical title or clinical-practice right.
routes.who_runs_it: The inviting Chilean university, under article 46 of Law 21.094; border entry remains controlled by Chilean migration authorities.
routes.why_not: She must remain resident/domiciled abroad, be invited for a university-organised academic activity, satisfy entry requirements and remain within the time limit. Clinical practice is not covered.
routes.account_creation: None centrally; the inviting university arranges the activity. Passport is the travel identity document.
steps: Obtain a formal university invitation for teaching, research, a conference or expert activity.
Satisfy Chilean entry requirements.
Limit the university-organised activity to 90 days or the shorter transient-stay period.
Do not perform patient care without separate medical authorisation.
routes.cost: No separate remunerated-activity-authorisation fee under this exemption; travel and entry costs remain.
routes.duration: Maximum 90 days or the end of the transient-stay permission, whichever comes first.
routes.evidence_quote: “estarán exentos de solicitar la autorización para desarrollar actividades remuneradas… [hasta] noventa días”
routes.history_note: The limit was increased from 30 working days to 90 days by Law 21.806, published on 5 February 2026.

routes.name_es: Homologación de la sección práctica del EUNACOM para titulares de reconocimientos de países determinados
routes.what_it_produces: After passing EUNACOM-ST and obtaining approval to homologate EUNACOM-SP, the candidate receives the full EUNACOM result without sitting the practical section. This supplies the EUNACOM-controlled public/FONASA/licence rights; it is not a Ukrainian-degree recognition route by itself.
routes.who_runs_it: EUNACOM/ASOFAMECH, based on a prior official MINREL or MINEDUC recognition certificate.
routes.why_not: The current EUNACOM page limits practical-section homologation to recognised titles listed there as Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Spain, United Kingdom and Uruguay. Her title was obtained in Ukraine.
routes.account_creation: Appointment booking followed by in-person filing; the candidate must present the official title-recognition certificate and identity document.
steps: First obtain an eligible treaty recognition certificate.
Pass EUNACOM-ST.
Pay the homologation fee and reserve an appointment.
File the original homologation form and recognition certificate in person.
Receive the full EUNACOM certificate if homologation is approved.
routes.cost: CLP 155,000 for practical-section homologation, plus the EUNACOM-ST fee.
routes.duration: Depends on ST and appointment scheduling.
routes.evidence_quote: “pueden solicitar homologar la sección práctica, sin necesidad de rendirla. La homologación… no es automática”
routes.history_note: The EUNACOM page still names Colombia, although Colombia is absent from MINREL’s current treaty-country list. The safest reading is that a candidate must possess an actual valid MINREL/MINEDUC recognition certificate.

routes.name_es: Reconocimiento excepcional de la Ley 19.074 para retornados/exiliados y specified family members
routes.what_it_produces: Historically, a special commission could issue recognition authorising nationwide professional practice and Registro Civil professional registration.
routes.who_runs_it: The former Comisión Especial and return/education authorities created by Law 19.074.
routes.why_not: It was restricted to specified Chilean returnees, certain naturalised Chileans and foreign spouses/children connected to pre-11 March 1990 forced departure. The final return/application deadlines expired in 1994–1995 and the commission was extinguished after its last case.
routes.account_creation: None; the historical process was paper-based.
steps: No new application can be made.
routes.cost: Not applicable.
routes.duration: Discontinued.
routes.evidence_quote: “sólo podrán recabarse por quienes hayan retornado al país hasta el 1° de marzo de 1994”
routes.history_note: Exceptional post-exile legislation; it is not a route for present-day migrants.

routes.name_es: Habilitación temporal de especialistas de la Ley 21.274
routes.what_it_produces: Historically, it temporarily authorised specified doctors with pending specialty-certification applications to practise their specialty in the public sector without completed certification and temporarily waived EUNACOM for qualifying foreign-trained doctors.
routes.who_runs_it: Public-sector employers, authorised specialty certifiers and the Superintendencia de Salud special registry.
routes.why_not: New entrants had to have their hiring reported before 10 April 2023. The three-year statutory period has also expired.
routes.account_creation: None for new applicants; the employer reported the historical hire to the Superintendencia.
steps: No new application can be made.
routes.cost: Not applicable for a new applicant.
routes.duration: Expired.
routes.evidence_quote: “Sólo podrán acogerse… [quienes] cuya contratación hubiera sido informada… antes del 10 de abril de 2023”
routes.history_note: A COVID-era bridge for pending specialist certification. The permanent successor relevant today is article 2 bis certification, not this expired law.

routes.name_es: Contratación de médicos con título extranjero no revalidado durante la alerta COVID-19
routes.what_it_produces: Historically, an emergency public-sector authorisation and special RNPI entry for foreign doctors whose titles had not been revalidated. It did not permanently recognise the degree.
routes.who_runs_it: MINSAL, public Health Services and the Superintendencia de Salud under COVID-19 Decreto 4/2020 and later amendments.
routes.why_not: The COVID sanitary alert ended, and the post-alert continuation period under Law 21.274 has also expired. It is not live on 6 September 2026.
routes.account_creation: Employer-driven historical route; no current applicant account.
steps: No new application can be made.
routes.cost: Not applicable.
routes.duration: Discontinued; the later statutory continuation could last only one year after the end of the COVID sanitary alert and was conditional on timely EUNACOM registration.
routes.evidence_quote: “médicos titulados en el extranjero cuyo título no esté revalidado o habilitado en Chile”. “hasta por el plazo de un año contado desde el término”
routes.history_note: This route is sometimes still described on old migration or health pages, but it cannot be used today.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: A public results/verification database, not the application portal. Universidad de Chile says it lists people who have already approved the process and warns: “Esta información es sólo referencial y no sustituye a los certificados oficiales.” Source: https://portaluchile.uchile.cl/presentacion/relaciones-internacionales/revalidacion-de-titulos-extranjeros/verificacion-en-linea-de-titulos-aprobados
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Employers, authorities and members of the public checking a completed Universidad de Chile result.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: The public search interface for the National Register of Individual Health Providers. It displays titles/specialties after validation; it does not recognise a foreign degree. The official application page says registration occurs “previa validación de la entidad habilitante.” Source: https://www.superdesalud.gob.cl/tramites/inscripcion-de-titulo-en-el-registro-nacional-de-prestadores-individuales-de-salud/
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Patients, employers and authorities checking whether a health professional’s title or specialty has been recorded.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: A certificate portal primarily for Chilean school-level records. Its foreign-study item concerns “estudios básicos y medios (no profesionales)”, not university medical degrees. Source: https://ayudamineduc.cl/ficha/reconocimiento-y-convalidacion-de-estudios-basicos-y-medios-no-profesionales-realizados-en-el
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: People obtaining school, secondary-education and related MINEDUC certificates.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: Apostille processing for specified Chilean educational documents intended for use abroad. The page says an apostille “simplifica la actual cadena de legalización”; it does not determine academic equivalence or authorise medical practice.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Holders of Chilean educational documents that must be authenticated for presentation abroad.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: A MINEDUC higher-education procedures directory/information page, not a general online filing system for recognition of Ukrainian professional or academic degrees.
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Users locating specific higher-education administrative procedures; treaty applicants must still use the country-specific channels.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: A regional health-authority services platform. Old Universidad de Chile guidance points to it for certain health-technical competency authorisations; that is not revalidation of the professional title Médico Cirujano. Source: https://portaluchile.uchile.cl/presentacion/relaciones-internacionales/revalidacion-de-titulos-extranjeros/procedimientos-segun-carreragrado
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Applicants for specific sanitary permits or regulated technical-health procedures, including an employer/SEREMI process where a particular legal exception applies.

portals_that_are_not_routes.what_it_actually_is: Chile’s labour-competency certification system. Universidad de Chile describes it as a place to consult about “alguna otra competencia laboral”; it cannot recognise a medical degree or certify a medical specialty. Source: https://portaluchile.uchile.cl/presentacion/relaciones-internacionales/revalidacion-de-titulos-extranjeros/procedimientos-segun-carreragrado
portals_that_are_not_routes.who_it_is_for: Workers seeking certification of occupational competencies outside the university medical-title recognition system.

bottom_line: For durable general medical practice, her realistic routes are: full EUNACOM, Universidad de Chile revalidation, or—once an eligible institution actually opens intake—medical revalidation at another qualifying State university. EUNACOM is the broadest single route because Law 20.261 says successful candidates “habrán revalidado automáticamente su título profesional de médico cirujano” (https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?cve=&i=&idLey=&idNorma=270584&idVersion=2025-05-24&tipoVersion=). For rheumatology, she separately needs specialty certification; article 2 bis can exceptionally permit public-sector rheumatology without general habilitation, but not private or general practice. For teaching, at least Universidad de Chile expressly permits an apostilled foreign diploma to support direct academic competition, so recognition of the doctorate is advantageous but not invariably a legal prerequisite. Her passport is sufficient to start Universidad de Chile and EUNACOM processes, but her lack of a Chilean RUT currently blocks CONACEM and the normal RNPI online path. None of these academic or professional processes itself grants immigration status: Universidad de Chile’s academic regulation expressly requires foreign academics to prove “el cumplimiento de las normas sobre extranjería” (https://portaluchile.uchile.cl/presentacion/senado-universitario/reglamentos/reglamentos-aprobados-o-modificados-por-el-senado-universitario/reglamento-general-de-carrera-academica-de-la-universidad-de-chile).
unknowns: No indexed qualifying State university was found that, by 6 September 2026, had published an operational Decreto 174 portal specifically accepting Medicine or an appropriate doctorate. The legal route is live, but the institution-by-institution intake layer is not yet transparent.

No current MINEDUC list or applicant portal was located for the Ministry’s discretionary article 143 power. It should not be treated as available to this Ukrainian degree unless MINEDUC publishes the required list.
No authoritative Chilean source was found declaring that the Ukrainian degree кандидат медичних наук automatically equals a Chilean Doctor degree. Each university must assess it.

No current public applicant manual was found specifying the exact passport/RUT documents, fee or processing period for an article 112 SEREMI medical permit or the exceptional public-shortage doctrine.

The Superintendencia’s current RNPI page offers both ClaveÚnica and non-ClaveÚnica links, but the non-ClaveÚnica service could not be fetched and passport-only online filing could not be confirmed; the known login asks for a RUT.

CONACEM’s requirements are clear, but the current portals, identity requirements, fees and foreign-training practices of every other MINSAL-authorised specialty certifier were not centrally published.

Universidad de Chile’s current guidance still contains the historical sentence that it is the only recognising institution. That statement became stale when Decreto 174 took effect on 17 August 2026 and should not be relied upon.

EUNACOM’s current practical-homologation page still lists Colombia, while MINREL’s current treaty page does not. An applicant should rely on possession of a valid official MINREL/MINEDUC recognition certificate, not merely the country name on the EUNACOM page.
